summary: Interoffice locker exchange and hotdesk provisioning for hybrid engineer relocating between LON and DUB
description:
Issue summary: New hire (Niamh O'Sullivan) on Product org is transitioning from the London office to a hybrid schedule with regular days in Dublin. Employee has company laptop, docking station, and monitor locked in a concierge locker in LON. She requests a secure locker pickup in London, sanitization of peripherals, and courier delivery to Dublin office followed by hotdesk allocation and temporary badge provisioning for first-week access.

Impact: Employee will be remote-first next week and needs hardware in DUB by 2026-03-18 to attend onboarding and cross-team syncs. Delay will impact onboarding schedule and productivity.

Location: London HQ (King's Cross site) locker #C17; destination Dublin office (3rd floor bench area).

Items to move: 1x MacBook Pro (company asset tag RWI-4762), 1x Thunderbolt dock, 1x 27in monitor (VESA mount), 1x cable pouch. Employee confirms no external drives in bag.

Safety & compliance: Requesting wipe/verify of external ports and surface sanitization before handover. Asset transfer must be recorded in inventory and asset-tag updated with new location. Badge temporary access required for Dublin site: week 1 (2026-03-18 to 2026-03-25) while corporate IT completes SSO onboarding.

Requested action: Facilities to collect locker contents on 2026-03-15 afternoon, process basic sanitization, package for next-business-day next-flight courier to Dublin with signature required, update asset inventory, and reserve hotdesk + temporary badge for 2026-03-18 morning. Also provide tracking number to reporter and CS for handoff.

Attachments/References: Link to locker photo and asset tags posted in #internal-facilities Slack (see thread TID: #fac-lon-locker-12105), and linked ticket INT-11021 for previous desk move notes.

Preferred pickup window: 2026-03-15 14:00-17:00 LON. Courier preference: internal vendor (Skyline Logistics) with signature and desk delivery to DUB reception.

Notes for shipping vendor: Mark package as "Company Equipment - Signature Required" and include packing checklist.
comments: 2026-03-12 - Olivia Chen: Created ticket after Niamh raised request in #people-onboarding. Confirmed locker number C17 and asset tags. Asked Facilities to confirm pickup window.
2026-03-12 - Diego Morales (Facilities): Assigned. Checking locker access with concierge and verifying courier availability for 2026-03-15. Will confirm ETA by EOD 2026-03-12.
2026-03-13 - Concierge LON (Amy Patel): Locker C17 has a single package matching description. Confirmed staff can pickup 15:00 on 2026-03-15. Photo uploaded to Slack thread.

2026-03-13 - Shipping Ops (Mateo Alvarez): Skyline Logistics confirmed next-flight slot for 2026-03-15 evening, delivery to DUB on 2026-03-16 morning. Quoted tracking number will be provided once collected. Noted customs not required (intra-EU).

2026-03-14 - IT Asset Manager (Priya Raman): Requested us to verify laptop encryption status and ensure laptop remains assigned to Niamh in asset tracker after transfer. Diego to confirm wipe is limited to surface sanitization only (no factory reset).

2026-03-14 - Diego Morales (Facilities): Update - Pickup scheduled 2026-03-15 15:30. Sanitization checklist prepared. Courier booking confirmed for Skyline SL-894. Will attach tracking and update asset record post-delivery. Reserving hotdesk DUB-3B for 2026-03-18 morning and enabling temporary badge.
